title: Is Prime Function
description:
Define a function `is_prime(n)` that returns `True` if n is prime, `False` otherwise. Use it to print all prime numbers from 2 to 20, space-separated on one line.

**Expected output:**
```
2 3 5 7 11 13 17 19
```
hint: For n < 2, return False. Loop from 2 to int(n**0.5)+1 and check if any number divides n evenly — if so return False. Otherwise return True.
